note: uBASIC (Adam Dunkels; Danyil Bohdan fork), a BSD-3-Clause line-numbered BASIC interpreter, cross-compiled to a 16-bit MS-DOS MZ .EXE with ia16-elf-gcc. It is DOS-NATIVE: it runs on the bw-board 8086 DOS service bench, reads PROG.BAS via INT 21h, and prints via the C library. Packaged as media-lab project projects/ubasic-dos (fetch.sh reproduces this byte-for-byte). Build tool ia16-elf-gcc is GPL but build-time only; the binary links permissive newlib + libi86.
